At 01:07-01:08, the waitress walks up to the counter opposite the man with empty hands. On the cut to 01:09, a white coffee mug suddenly appears in her right hand, which she sets down at 01:13 right next to the white mug the man is already holding. When the camera cuts back to the wide shot at 01:18, this second mug on the counter in front of the man has disappeared.

Although the waitress already picked up and carried away the man's plate at 01:14-01:17, a plate is back on the counter next to the coffee mug at 01:50. The waitress then picks up both the plate and the mug at 01:51, and as she moves behind the counter at 01:52-01:53, both objects vanish from her hands.
